name: Verify that the Create News form contains the particular fields.
description:
Test to validate all fields and interactions in the Edit News form.

    Steps:
    1. Set window size and switch language.
    2. Verify Title field behavior: append, prepend, remove characters.
    3. Verify Tags field: selection, deselection, limits.
    4. Verify Image Upload component: visibility, error messages, cropper buttons, change image.
    5. Verify Source field: value, validation message.
    6. Verify Content field: visibility, toolbar, counter, messages, append/prepend/remove content.
    7. Verify Author field.
    8. Verify Post Date field.
    9. Verify Publish/Edit, Preview, Cancel buttons.
    10. Verify Cancel modal functionality.
    11. Verify News Preview page.
    12. Verify Edit News after returning from preview.
